title: Yelin group meditation: synchronized binaural session with about 30 people and orb contact
summary: Jordan Jos tells of Yelin group meditation: synchronized binaural session with about 30 people and orb contact, about an unknown time at Yelin (outdoor setting), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So what that looked like is I took a group of about 30 people.

plain: Jordan Jos, a man who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, describes on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels leading a group of about 30 people in an outdoor meditation at a place called Yelin. He says they all listened together to binaural sound, a technique that plays a slightly different tone in each ear, and that glowing orbs appeared and made contact. If true, it would suggest people can call these things in by focusing their minds together.
